label: risky
summary: Resolved fast-xml-parser 4.2.3 matches GHSA-6w63-h3fj-q4vw; this expectation is limited to that advisory.

findings.title: DEP-003: fast-xml-parser 4.2.3 is affected by CVE-2023-34104
findings.description: The added dependency resolves to fast-xml-parser 4.2.3, within the affected range >=4.1.3, <4.2.4 for GHSA-6w63-h3fj-q4vw / CVE-2023-34104. Crafted XML entity names can cause denial of service during parsing.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to a version outside the affected range; 4.2.4 fixes this advisory. Check other advisories before selecting a target version.

evidence.observation: The node_modules/fast-xml-parser entry resolves to 4.2.3. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6w63-h3fj-q4vw identifies npm fast-xml-parser >=4.1.3, <4.2.4 as affected, with 4.2.4 patched and High severity (CVSS 7.5).

uncertainty: Whether untrusted XML reaches the parser and whether processEntities is disabled are unknown.
This is an affected-version match, not evidence of exploitation.
